Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly assumed that "Maria Luisa of Savoy" referred to Marie Thérèse Louise of Savoy, Princesse de Lamballe, rather than the more historically prominent figure, Maria Luisa Gabriella of Savoy (Queen of Spain). This error led the entire multi-agent process down the wrong path, causing the WebSurfer to search for the wrong individuals and ultimately conclude that the father-in-law was Louis de Bourbon-Toulouse, Duke of Penthièvre. The correct answer, Louis, Grand Dauphin, corresponds to Maria Luisa Gabriella's husband, Philip V of Spain. The Planner's failure to prioritize the most common historical reference or to verify the ambiguity before directing the search constituted the root cause of the error.
